'''Natley Lewin''' is a [[Two Rivers]] resident. He is married to [[Laila Lewin]].

== Appearance ==
He is very wide, even wider than Laila.

== Activities ==
He was present on the [[al'Seen]] farm when [[Perrin]] visited with Faile. While emphasizing the dangers of remaining on the farm, Perrin used Natley's infant as an example of something the [[Trolloc]]s could destroy that couldn't be rebuilt.{{ref/book|4|32}}
